scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run e2e:stage && wdio run tests/e2e/wdio.conf.mts
scripts.test:e2e:no-build: npm run e2e:stage && wdio run tests/e2e/wdio.conf.mts
scripts.test:e2e:smoke: npm run build && npm run e2e:stage && wdio run tests/e2e/wdio.conf.mts --spec tests/e2e/00-boot.spec.ts --spec tests/e2e/10-gallery.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:gallery: npm run build && npm run e2e:stage && wdio run tests/e2e/wdio.conf.mts --spec tests/e2e/00-boot.spec.ts --spec tests/e2e/10-gallery.spec.ts --spec tests/e2e/11-places-map.spec.ts --spec tests/e2e/19-media-list-view.spec.ts --spec tests/e2e/21-places-feed-mode.spec.ts
scripts.test:e2e:explorer: npm run build && npm run e2e:stage && wdio run tests/e2e/wdio.conf.mts --spec tests/e2e/00-boot.spec.ts --spec tests/e2e/12-explorer.spec.ts
scripts.capture:promo: npm run build && npm run e2e:stage && PROMO_CAPTURE=1 wdio run tests/e2e/wdio.conf.mts --spec tests/e2e/99-promo-capture.spec.ts
scripts.capture:promo:burst: npm run build && npm run e2e:stage && PROMO_CAPTURE=1 PROMO_BURST=1 wdio run tests/e2e/wdio.conf.mts --spec tests/e2e/99b-promo-video-burst.spec.ts
scripts.promo:exp:a: npm run capture:promo && npm run promo:verify
scripts.promo:exp:b: npm run promo:exp:a && npm run promo:slideshow
scripts.promo:exp:c: npm run capture:promo:burst && npm run promo:bursts:encode && tsx scripts/promo/verify-capture.mts --bursts
scripts.promo:experiments: npm run promo:exp:a && npm run promo:exp:b && npm run promo:exp:c && npm run promo:exp:d && tsx scripts/promo/verify-capture.mts --bursts --videos
